# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityOpenAuctionRangeAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True
        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._spy.high = 0
        self._spy.low = 1
        self._spy.in_range = False
        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._spy.symbol),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy.symbol, 30),
            self._exit_open_auction_range_order
        )

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        bar = slice.bars.get(self._spy)
        if not bar:
            return
        # 9:30 AM - 10:00 AM price range play
        if not self._spy.in_range:
            if bar.high > self._spy.high:
                self._spy.high = bar.high
            if bar.low < self._spy.low:
                self._spy.low = bar.low
            self._spy.in_range = True
        elif bar.close > self._spy.high:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy.symbol, 1.0)
            self._spy.in_range = False
        elif bar.close < self._spy.low:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy.symbol, -1.0)
            self._spy.in_range = False

    def _exit_open_auction_range_order(self) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            self.liquidate()
        self._spy.in_range = False
